      from pathlib import Path
      import shutil
      import sys

      output = Path(sys.argv[1])
      events = [json.loads(line) for line in (output / "cargo-messages.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
      scripts = [event for event in events if event.get("reason") == "build-script-executed" and "aos-hub-api" in event["package_id"]]

      shutil.copytree(scripts[0]["out_dir"], output / "generated-api")
      assert (output / "generated-api/aos.hub.v1.rs").is_file()
      PYGEN
    '';
